description: Turn auto-refill on or off for this key. On = whenever usage runs low a pack is bought with the card on file, so an agent never hits out_of_usage. Enabling charges money later: confirm the pack and price with the user first. Needs a card on file (buy one pack with frontrun_topup first if not).

enabled.description: true to turn auto-refill on, false to turn it off.

pack.description: Pack id to buy each time. Omit to keep the current one (or the smallest).

name: frontrun_auto_refill
